q1: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
q2: WITH TEMP AS(SELECT DISTINCT A.FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWERS, A.FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW A JOIN FOLLOW B ON A.FOLLOWEE = B.FOLLOWEE WHERE A.FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW)) SELECT FOLLOWERS AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(*) AS NUM FROM TEMP GROUP BY FOLLOWERS ORDER BY FOLLOWER
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent. Q1 selects followers who are also being followed by someone else and counts how many followers each of them has. Q2, on the other hand, selects followers who are being followed by the same person who is following someone else and counts how many followers each of them has.
counterexample_dsp: A user A who is being followed by user B, and user B is also following user C.
